in_marathi.name: Dhar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Maintainer, Holder, Protector
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Dhar originates from the Sanskrit word 'dhru' which means 'that which holds'. It is a name that signifies strength and stability, as well as the idea of duty and responsibility. The name Dhar is often given to children as a reminder of their role in upholding the values and traditions of their family and community.
